content.overview: Section 245 allows a class of members or depositors to seek Tribunal orders restraining ultra vires or fraudulent conduct and claiming damages.
content.glance: Section 245 allows a class of members or depositors to seek Tribunal orders restraining ultra vires or fraudulent conduct and claiming damages.
content.study: The action can target the company, directors, auditors and experts. Thresholds are prescribed. The Tribunal considers good faith, alternative remedy, and evidence. Findings bind the class. This is distinct from a derivative action and from s. 241.
